verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only vaguely references scanning 'configuration files' as one custom-rule use case, with no explicit mention of Terraform, Kubernetes manifests, or IaC-specific misconfiguration rulesets/registry packs. Missing for 10: documentation of Terraform/Kubernetes-specific rule packs, examples of IaC misconfiguration findings, and any hands-on or community evidence of IaC scanning in practice.
